title: Official-style cooperative hexapod Push-T: protocol verification and initial learning probes

protocol.success: coverage > 0.95 and no physical failure; immediate termination, no pose hold criterion
protocol.failure: robot fall, cargo fall or out of bounds

actions.meaning: Per-robot world XY target position in meters

observations.keypoints: 16 world XY components for corners of two physical rectangles, own XY, own heading, peer poses; no visibility mask

necessary_deviations_from_official_2d: 3D articulated hexapods with frozen learned gait, instead of one circular kinematic pusher
Multiple pushers require own heading and peer poses
Meter units and hexapod velocity limits/gains, instead of pixel units and circle PD gains
Requested T-to-goal-to-robots layout and reset ranges retained
Requested equal bar/stem centerline lengths retained: 1.3 meters for two robots
5 Hz upper control, 25 Hz gait, 200 Hz physics instead of official 10 Hz upper control
Keypoint observation is a team array, rather than the gym-pusht environment_state_agent_pos dictionary

training.algorithm: TorchRL MAPPO; shared local actor, central critic, per-agent ratios
training.reset_rng: torch CUDA; uniform reset ranges match native MuJoCo

development_evaluation.role: Development probe, not untouched thesis test cases
development_evaluation.warp_initial_states: qpos, qvel and goal copied from native MuJoCo resets for each seed; later states simulated by Warp

provenance.checkpoint_distribution: Local audit artifact only; not published as a successful transport model

fixed_task_trials.progress_csv_newlines: Normalized to LF; all recorded values unchanged

cuda_task_and_legacy_warp_suite.code_revision: Final implementation including decoupled Push-T discount from legacy potential shaping

verification.geometry_oracle: NumPy and Torch float64 compared with independent Shapely over 260 poses for each of two and four robots; absolute tolerance 1e-12. CUDA float32 absolute tolerance 2e-5. Includes coincident and cardinal-angle edges.
verification.real_mappo_updates: Two and four robots on CPU and Warp; Collector, GAE, backward, Adam, checkpoint reload and native/Warp evaluation

notebook_initial_cuda_smoke.scope: Earlier run of all research code cells excluding installation; one real CUDA rollout per condition; aggregate evaluation seeds97000..97001, manual/video examples also use seed96000; execution check only

final_cuda_notebook_smoke.scope: All research code cells, installation excluded; one actual CUDA MAPPO rollout (65,536 team steps) per condition; verifies execution, not learning performance

limitations: One training seed per condition; 24 development cases reused for inspection, not final thesis evaluation
Short one-million-step runs only; no claim that position representation alone solves exploration
Successful transport model not available for the new protocol
Legacy 42-second adaptation and 95-97% mean success results apply only to the old velocity/pose task
Notebook smoke uses a reduced training budget and verifies execution, not learned performance
